title: Last character of lines is invisible in text editor when using <100% editor display scale
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.stable
_NOT_ reproducible in 4.4.1.stable (regression)

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7652) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700F CPU @ 2.90GHz (16 threads) - 15.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using a custom editor display scale of less than 100% (in my case, 86%), the last character on the longest line in any file in the text editor becomes invisible. In the GIF below, there is actually a closing parenthesis at the end of the line `)`, but it doesn't show up.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9713312c-b717-4000-95a5-b17ecbb87f47)

Here is the exact same code in `4.4.1.stable`. Notice how the parenthesis is visible:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1b89b4b2-34b0-4273-8e64-c7d000a35cdc)

Details:
- This happens when the longest line extends beyond the width of the text editor (i.e. you have to scroll to it).
- This happens regardless if the minimap is enabled
- This happens regardless of text editor zoom level

### Steps to reproduce

- Open attached project, and open up `test.gd` in the script editor.
- Shrink down the text editor horizontally, or zoom in, until the longest line is too long for the text editor.
- Go to the end of the line, and observe that the last character is invisible.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bug-report-2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22550206/bug-report-2.zip)
